summary: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) : — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items:  Objective: Provide free LPG connections to 8 crore underprivileged families by 2020.
 12 annual refills with ₹300 subsidy per cylinder.
 Beneficiaries: Women from SC/ST, BPL, Antyodaya, tea garden workers, islanders, forest
